annotation.title_clean: Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2023/1675 correcting certain language versions of Delegated Regulation (EU) 2021/1958 (intelligent speed assistance systems type-approval)
annotation.title_en: Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2023/1675 correcting certain language versions of Delegated Regulation (EU) 2021/1958 (intelligent speed assistance systems type-approval)
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union
annotation.summary_en: Short EU Commission delegated regulation correcting the German and Lithuanian language versions of Delegated Regulation 2021/1958 on type-approval test procedures and technical requirements for intelligent speed assistance systems in motor vehicles. It has no effect on the English text.
key_provisions_or_claims: Corrects German and Lithuanian versions of point 5.1 of Annex I of Regulation 2021/1958 (observation sensor field of vision).
Article 1 does not concern the English version.
Enters into force on the twentieth day after publication in the Official Journal.
Binding in its entirety and directly applicable in all Member States.
